overview: The Medford Community Development Board approved meeting minutes and granted a permit extension for the Macklin Road subdivision. The board also reviewed the city's ongoing zoning recodification effort and voted to submit board feedback to the Community Development Director.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes for August 20, 2020, and September 16, 2020.

items.title: Macklin Road Subdivision Extension
items.summary: Approved a permit time extension through June 30, 2021, for the Macklin Road subdivision project.

items.title: Zoning Review and Board Rules Discussion
items.summary: The board reviewed the city's zoning recodification process and voted to direct staff to send board feedback and questions regarding zoning criteria and board procedures to the Community Development Director.
